From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: James Lee <james.lee@acme-ops.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Action items: schedule demo deep-dive + evidence request

Hi Olivia / James —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to lock the next steps:

- Key pain: unpredictable inference latency at peak and rising per-token costs for custom reranking.
- Must-haves: SSO (SAML), VPC peering for private deployments, and a clear audit trail for sensitive PII inference.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep-dive (60 min) with our Solutions Engineer to validate latency numbers and run a short architecture fit assessment.
2) Security sync (30 min) with your InfoSec to walk through evidence model (SOC2, network diagram, data flow).
3) Procurement touchpoint to surface purchase path and timing.

Please confirm who from your side should join (security/procurement). Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu, Dec 3 — 10:00–11:15
- Fri, Dec 4 — 11:00–12:00
- Tue, Dec 8 — 09:30–10:30

I’m looping Marissa Cole (SE) and Karthik Iyer (legal/ops support) so we can include the right folks if you confirm. I attached a working mutual action plan (MAP) and included a quick agenda below. If you prefer, send a calendar link and we’ll accept.

Agenda for 60-min deep-dive:
- 0–10 min: goals & success criteria (your team)
- 10–30 min: current workload walk-through + data sensitivity
- 30–45 min: Redwood architecture & runbook for production inference
- 45–60 min: open Q&A + next milestones (pilot/POC)

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
